label: Sfx: Censer's cast (the thurible swing) and disc-bell arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: v78 s4's two new voices, in the synth only: the cast's thurible swing (a chain-rattle into a low bell) and the disc's soft bell pitched by the discs standing; the heal is the existing spark collect and the smite tick has no voice. Code's picks on the numbers under Rick's 'you pick i overrule': cast 4 JINGLE, disc 2 BOWL (censer_voice_lab.py). The arms go BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback (mode `before`, its anchor the fallback line itself), so the 11 other relics that still fall through keep it and another relic's row anchored there applies in either order. Through the patched play() each arm reproduces its lab candidate (worst 9e-08), 132 other voices are unchanged (worst 2e-07), and ult/censer is no longer rune-crack. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the new voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 6e-08).
